arguments.message: Hello team, this is Tiana. I have strong skills in security with 0.87 match, and 6 hours available. I am considering claiming one of the security tasks: implement (effort 7.0, critical priority), review (3.5 effort, critical), or test (4.9 effort, critical). My costs are lowest for review (3.62) and highest for implement (8.25). Given my availability, review or test might be more feasible. Please share your plans or preferences for these or other tasks so we can avoid conflicts and optimize the sprint outcome.
